events.verdict: McDaniels (MIN) legally contests Fox's (SAC) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Fox (SAC) reaches across and in front of McDaniels' (MIN) body and the contact with his left shoulder is marginal.
Sabonis (SAC) extends a hand into McDaniels' (MIN) body, accelerating him and affecting his shot attempt near the rim.
Edwards (MIN) briefly has a hand placed on Monk's (SAC) body, which he removes and does not affect Monk's shot attempt.
Reid (MIN) releases away from Crowder (SAC) to receive the pass.
Conley (MIN) establishes himself in a screening position in Crowder's (SAC) path and absorbs the contact.
Monk (SAC) hooks his off-arm around Conley (MIN) and initiates illegal contact with his head.
Sabonis (SAC) briefly places both hands on Randle (MIN) as he releases and the contact does not affect Randle's FOM.
Sabonis (SAC) firms up in a defensive position in Randle's (MIN) path, absorbing the body contact before he cleanly dislodges the ball from Randle's possession.
Sabonis (SAC) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Randle (MIN) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it from Fox's (SAC) possession. Any ensuing contact after the dislodge is incidental.
Monk (SAC) makes contact to Edwards' (MIN) left elbow, affecting his shot attempt. The illegal contact occurs before Murray (SAC) blocks the shot attempt.
Sabonis (SAC) collapses his forearm and the contact during Edwards' (MIN) putback attempt is marginal.
